name: SHPR-10C
summary: SHPR-10C is a precision cycloidal reducer in Fine-Motion’s SHPR-C family for joint transmission. Its official model page provides an output-shaft bolted-mount dimensional drawing and a rating table that distinguishes output speed, output torque, starting/stopping loads and momentary limits. Reducer selection requires the applicable ratio and operating condition.
